name: Gráinne O’Neill
biography: is a the Director of the MyGideon project at the Charles Hamilton Houston Institute for Race and Justice at Harvard Law School. She is also a board member of the National Lawyers Guild and in that role Coordinates the Anonlg Project. Anonlg is a national network of NLG attorneys who provide defense to targeted hacktivists. She received her JD from Columbia Law School where she was the Managing Editor of the Jailhouse Lawyers Manual, and has a degree in computer science from Cornell University. ( ) Twitter: @grainne
